verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Close does general 'pipeline management' and that opportunities have a customizable status (active/won/lost). Nothing documents running multiple separate pipelines, each with its own stage set for different products or motions. A single customizable status list is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for multiple pipelines.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run multiple pipelines with different stage sets for different products or motions

citations.quote: Opportunities have a customizable status (which always has a `status_type` of either `active`, `won`, or `lost`)
It combines calling, email, SMS, pipeline management, reporting, and an AI sales agent named Chloe into a single platform.
